items.reviewNote: Disséquons describes anatomical study of insects. The I disséqua_anatomical plan and all three questions, plus VI disséqué, were read. The present plural surface shares that planned French verb meaning; no tense-only sense is created. All plural verbs accept le, while opening the body for study differs from drawing, feeding or release.

Mouches are actual insects dissected by the philosophers, not decorative beauty patches. The global insect meaning, its complete three-band singular bank and the exact plural patches bank were read. Add the plural surface on the existing proper mouche noun insect sense. Mouches/araignées/chenilles/limaces are feminine plural nouns; flying and buzzing distinguish the target without a grammar filter or biological claim about the narrative specimens.

Mesurons des lignes determines geometric lengths. The VI measured-dimensions bank was re-read in all three bands; share that planned French mesurer verb and meaning, without a present-tense-only identity. Every verb takes les and nous; determining dimensions differs from weighing, drawing or moving.

Lignes names geometric one-dimensional objects studied by measurement, not lines of prose or a family lineage. No global or earlier proper ligne family exists. Lignes/surfaces/sphères/masses are feminine plural nouns in des; the explicit one-dimensional clue excludes surfaces, spheres and masses without implying all lines are straight.

Assemblons des nombres describes combining numbers in arithmetic. No global or earlier assembler verb exists. Prepare the ordinary bringing-together meaning rather than a special arithmetic-only lemma. All four plural verbs take les; bringing elements together differs from separation, erasure or disregard.

Nombres are abstract numerical quantities used in arithmetic. The earlier II nombre_count meaning and its three questions were read. Share its proper French noun and quantity meaning, with conceptual scope reconciliation of counted and abstract numbers before import rather than a plural-only sense. Nombres/coloris/contours/poids are masculine plural nouns, including the invariant plural spellings; numerical values rather than color, outline or weight select nombres.

Deux ou trois points refers to matters understood by the philosophers, not tiny instants, opportune moments or negation point. The global point noun and adverb owners and earlier II point_tiny_instant plan were read. Prepare the discussion-topic meaning under the existing proper noun owner. Points/lieux/moments/trous are masculine plural nouns; the stated subjects of debate exclude spatial places, time and physical holes.

Both entendons mean understanding philosophical points, once positively and once under n’…pas. The global hear and intend senses and the VI understanding bank were read in all bands. Share the planned understanding meaning under entendre, with no polarity-, object- or tense-only sense. All four plural verbs accept les; grasping meaning differs from forgetting, hiding or distorting.

Il prit fantaisie aux deux visiteurs is the onset of a spontaneous desire to question the philosophers. The exact earlier VII prend-onset bank and all three questions were read, with Académie 1762 envie/fantaisie evidence. Share that same proper prendre verb meaning; the separate prit la parole occurrence is a whole idiom. All choices are grammatical verb labels in a quoted-construction prompt, and onset rather than passing, lack or persistence selects prit.

Prit fantaisie names the visitors’ sudden wish to question the humans. No global or earlier proper fantaisie noun exists. Académie 1762 directly records this spontaneous-desire construction. Fantaisie/certitude/nécessité/habitude are feminine singular nouns after une; a wish differs from knowledge, requirement or routine, without treating it as imagination of a nonexistent object.

Interroger ces atomes pensants means asking the humans questions to learn their agreed knowledge. No global or earlier French interroger verb exists. Every infinitive takes the unchanged direct object les; asking for information differs from providing it, ignoring people or congratulating them. No interrogation-by-authorities-only sense or literal questioning of physical atoms is created.

Choses refers to agreed matters in186 and possible realities in208; the214 le bout des choses span reuses the complete expression bank. The broad proper chose noun and its three physical-object questions were read. Add an abstract-reference bank on the same generic thing meaning, with scope reconciliation before import; neither abstractness nor plurality alone creates a second generic sense. Choses/personnes/localités/dates are feminine plural nouns; the clue explicitly excludes persons, places and dates.

Les choses dont ils convenaient are matters on which the philosophers agreed. The global agree/settle meaning, its three questions and I conviendront_agree bank were read; exclude suitability convient. Add the imperfect plural surface on the same proper convenir agreement meaning. All four en predicates are viable; accepted agreement differs from doubt, ongoing debate or lying.

La grande étoile des Gémeaux identifies a prominent star in the narrator’s wording. The published importance/intensity/ampleur grand meaning and all three questions, plus VI physical-size grande bank, were read. Add an importance-context bank on that broad adjective sense, without independently asserting the star’s physical diameter or luminosity. All alternatives agree feminine singular; importance rather than smallness, secondary status or insignificance selects grande.

Nous disputons sur des points is the older debating construction, supported by the source contrast between agreed and disputed subjects. No global or earlier French disputer verb exists. Académie1762 records arguing questions on both sides with the non-pronominal construction. The authored independent retrieval sentence uses the modern pronominal form of the same arguing meaning under the proper disputer headword; final import must compare this construction without making a reflexive-only sense. Every plural predicate accepts nous nous; opposed arguments rather than agreement, silence or reconciliation select disputons. This is intellectual debate, not necessarily a physical fight.

Degrés measures angular separation between the named stars, not temperature or educational rank. No global or earlier French degré noun exists. Degrés/radians/tours/secteurs are masculine plural nouns; the exact fractional-turn definition distinguishes degrees from radians, full turns and sectors. The narrative angular amount is not independently verified by this vocabulary bank.

Et demi after degrés adds a half-degree. Académie9 sectionI explicitly classifies demi after et as an adjective agreeing in gender with the preceding unit and remaining singular. Do not import it as a nominal half-unit or create a separate half-degree-only sense. All alternatives are metalinguistic word labels rather than sentence substitutions; half rather than a quarter, third or tenth selects demi. No existing global or earlier demi owner exists.

Demi-diamètres de la terre supplies the historical distance unit of Earth radii in the story. No global or earlier proper demi-diamètre noun exists. Demi-diamètres/diamètres/côtés/périmètres are masculine plural nouns; the center-to-edge half-diameter clue distinguishes radii without validating the narrative Earth–Moon ratio as a current astronomical fact.

Both pèse ask or state the weight of air. The global moral-burden sense and IV pesaient_weighed bank were read in all three bands. Share the earlier planned physical-weight meaning under proper existing peser rather than moral pressure or a present-only new meaning. All four finite predicates fit the subject and a numerical complement; weight rather than price, content or count selects pèse. Source comparisons remain attributed narrative measurements.

Votre air and l’air denote the physical atmospheric gas mixture whose weight is being discussed, not appearance or manner. The existing proper air noun and all appearance questions were read. Prepare the atmospheric meaning on that same lemma. Air/oxygène/azote/ozone are masculine singular vowel-initial nouns fitting l’; the mixture rather than a single constituent gas selects air, with no agreement or elision filter.

Il croyait les attraper means catching the philosophers out with a question, not grabbing a fleeing person or catching a chill. The published physical-trap, catching-person and cold meanings with their banks were read. Académie9 records figurative deceiving. Prepare the trick/catch-out meaning under the same proper attraper verb, with overlap review of trap language before import. Each infinitive takes les; inducing an error differs from information, reassurance or praise.

Un pareil volume compares equal spatial amounts of air and water. No global or earlier volume noun exists. Volume/périmètre/diamètre/poids are masculine singular nouns; three-dimensional occupied space differs from boundary length, a through-center length or weight. The later bound-book volume is a distinct meaning under this same proposed proper volume noun owner; do not create duplicate lemmas or validate the narrative density ratio.

Ce volume is the complete book the Sirian delivers, revealed as blank at the Academy, not a spatial measurement. Prepare the bound-book meaning under the single proposed proper volume noun owner also used for spatial extent; keep these two semantic meanings distinct. Volume/feuillet/paragraphe/chapitre are masculine singular nouns; a complete bound book differs from one leaf or textual subdivisions. No new lemma per homographic sense is allowed.

La plus légère describes low weight for the water used in the story’s comparison. The global low-weight/agility adjective and all three questions were read. Add the feminine surface on the same physical low-weight meaning; adjective gender and superlative construction do not create a fresh sense. All alternatives agree feminine singular. This explains the narrator’s comparison without asserting a special kind of scientifically verified lightest water.

Dix-neuf is the numerical multiplier in the stated air-to-gold comparison. No global or earlier French dix-neuf family exists. All four numerical expressions fit the arithmetic prompt; the sum determines nineteen. The bank does not validate nineteen thousand as an actual physical density ratio or create a context-only arithmetic identity.

L’or de ducat refers to gold associated with the historical coin. No global or earlier French ducat noun exists. Académie9 records an old coin, usually gold and sometimes silver, with value varying by place. Ducat/lingot/bracelet/chandelier are masculine singular nouns; being a coin rather than a block of metal, jewelry or a lighting object selects ducat. No modern conversion price, fixed gold purity or country-exclusive meaning is asserted.

Réponses names the philosophers’ replies to the giants’ measurement questions. No global or earlier proper réponse noun exists; the répondre verb cannot own the noun. Réponses/questions/hésitations/demandes are feminine plural nouns after des. Replies supplying requested information differ from asking, hesitation or requesting, with no noun-agreement filter.

Fut tenté de prendre les philosophes pour des sorciers expresses an inclination, not an attempt actually carried out or someone physically tested. No global or earlier tenter verb exists. Prepare the desire-arousing meaning under proper French tenter, without inventing a separate participial lemma. All four masculine singular predicates fit il est; inclination rather than prevention or deterrence selects tenté. The character’s suspicion does not verify supernatural powers.

Prendre pour des sorciers means regarding the philosophers as sorcerers, often mistaken identification. The exact charge/trick surface banks and the global regard-as meaning with all three prise questions were read. Add the infinitive on the existing proper prendre regard-as sense. The alternatives are grammatical verb labels in a construction-identification prompt; identify-as rather than separation, distinction or protection selects prendre. The pour route in package02 remains paired with this exact semantic construction before import.

Sorciers names the supposed magical practitioners in the Saturnian’s tentative interpretation of human knowledge. No global or earlier proper sorcier noun exists. Sorciers/savants/artisans/médecins are masculine plural nouns after des; attributed magical power differs from study, craft or medical practice. The bank explains the character’s suspicion without asserting magic as real or classifying the philosophers as actual sorcerers.

Ces mêmes gens resumes exactly those people who had earlier been denied souls, emphasizing the reversal in the Saturnian’s judgment. The global same, identical and emphatic-identity meanings, and the exact mêmes postposed bank, were read. Add this preposed-identity bank on the existing broad proper adjective same sense; whole-family overlap reconciliation must preserve old mastery before import. All alternatives agree with plural personnes; the clue selects identity over difference or novelty.

Auxquels resumes gens as recipients of the Saturnian’s earlier refusal of a soul. The global proper contracted-relative owner and all three auquel questions were read. Add the masculine plural form on that same à+lequel meaning, without an animate-only or plural-only sense. All options are grammatical pronoun labels in the metalinguistic prompt; à contraction rather than de, bare relative or demonstrative reference selects auxquels.

Il avait refusé forms a completed earlier action, not possession. The published lexical avait bank and the global compound auxiliary’s full three-band bank were read. Add this imperfect singular surface on that existing proper avoir auxiliary meaning; tense does not create a fresh sense. Alternatives are viable verb labels in the metalinguistic prompt, and auxiliary function selects avait. The lexical possession in211 and existential il y avait in210 are routed separately.

Il y avait là un petit animalcule presents the existence or presence of another philosopher. The global existential avoir meaning and its three questions were read, excluding lexical possession and compound auxiliary. Add the imperfect surface on the same proper avoir existential sense; retain the indispensable y component and earlier IV missing-y repair dependency before import. All four singular predicates accept il y and a following subject; existence differs from remaining, passing or disappearance.

Refusé une âme means denying or refusing to acknowledge a soul in the human philosophers. No global or earlier French refuser verb exists. Every participle fits le leur a; withholding rather than granting, recognizing or promising selects refusé. Keep the source’s philosophical denial rather than claim that souls are material objects or that the denial is true.

All eight âme uses concern the philosophers’ proposed principle of life and thought, contrasted with body or matter. Académie1762 records the animating and thinking principle; the existing moral/affective inner-self sense and all three banks were read. Prepare the philosophical life/thought scope under the same proper âme noun, with explicit overlap reconciliation of inner-self and philosophical soul before import. Âme/idée/image/illusion are feminine singular vowel-initial nouns fitting l’; the proposed animating principle differs from a thought, representation or deception. No assertion of its existence or of one philosophical theory’s correctness is made.

Un quart d’heure is a quarter of an hour, not a navigational quadrant or an angular instrument. The global fraction meaning and all three quarts questions were read. Add the singular surface on that same proper noun fraction sense, without a time-only or number-only meaning. Quart/demi/tiers/cinquième are masculine singular fractional nouns; a four-part denominator selects quart.

Auparavant locates the denial of a soul earlier and compares the later simultaneous speech with previous speech. No global or earlier French auparavant adverb exists. All four adverbs are viable time labels in the unchanged prompt; earlier rather than later, present or future time selects auparavant. Comparison with previous speech does not create a separate comparison-only sense.

Encore mieux intensifies the comparative, meaning even better, rather than merely continuing to know. The global comparative encore/encor meaning and all three historical-form questions were read, as was the exact generic continuation bank. Add the modern surface on the same proper encore comparative sense; spelling does not create a new meaning. All four alternatives are grammatical adverb labels in the metalinguistic prompt; additional comparative degree differs from approximation, earlier time or low frequency.

Formez vos idées asks how thoughts are formed, not self-cultivation se former l’esprit or things coming into being under se former. The earlier I cultivation and V formation proposals and their banks were read. Prepare this intentional creation/shaping meaning under the same proper planned former verb, with overlap reconciliation of mental cultivation and composition before import, rather than a new lemma. All four plural verbs take les; producing an idea differs from forgetting, rejecting or concealing it.

Parlèrent describes all philosophers speaking together. The published parler speech definition and all three parlé questions, plus VI parla/parlaient banks, were read. Add the past plural surface to the same proper French parler speech meaning, with no tense-only identity and no implication that their simultaneous answers agreed. Each plural predicate fits ils; spoken expression differs from writing, sleep or singing.

Différents avis are plural opinions, not notices posted publicly. The existing opinion meaning and three exact avis questions were read; its middle noun alternatives were singular. Author a plural-context bank on the same invariant surface and same opinion meaning: avis/projets/voyages/récits are masculine plural nouns. Before import reconcile shared-bank selection and every current/historical dependent avis question, preserving old mastery; plurality does not create a fresh sense or identity.

Le plus vieux names the oldest philosopher directly, while un vieux péripatéticien and le vieux secrétaire remain adjective uses. The global old adjective owner and all three questions were read; no proper nominal owner exists. Académie1798 explicitly records vieux as a substantive. Prepare substantive vieux under its own French noun ownership, while comparing the age concept before import. Vieux/jeune/enfant/adolescent are masculine singular substantive noun labels in the metalinguistic prompt, avoiding a superlative construction that would reject distractors by syntax. Do not create separate old-versus-oldest noun meanings.

Citait Aristote names quoting or invoking Aristotle’s writings as authority; the following speech quotes a purported passage. No global or earlier French citer verb exists. All singular imperfect predicates accept le; citing as support differs from disregard, rejection or criticism. The bank does not verify the attributed quotation, page reference or the speaker’s understanding of the text.

Prononçait le nom de Descartes is saying a name aloud, not issuing a judicial decision or a phonetic-correctness judgment. The earlier VI prononça speech bank and all three questions were read. Add the imperfect form to the same planned proper prononcer meaning, with no name-only or tense-only sense. All four singular predicates take les; utterance differs from writing, erasing or forgetting.

Un vieux péripatéticien directly names a follower of Aristotle, rather than an adjective modifying a separate philosopher noun. No global or earlier proper péripatéticien owner exists. Académie9 records this masculine noun and its separate adjectival use. Péripatéticien/cartésien/leibnitzien/lockien are masculine singular philosophical-follower nouns; the named doctrine selects the target, without validating the character’s alleged Aristotelian quotation.

Avec confiance describes the peripatetic speaker’s assurance, not financial credit or necessarily trust placed in another person. No global or earlier proper confiance noun exists. Confiance/hésitation/incertitude/méfiance are feminine singular nouns after avec, with no elision filter. Assurance differs from hesitation, uncertainty or distrust; being confident does not establish that the assertion is true.

The peripatetic calls the soul une entéléchie. Académie1762 explains essential form constituting an individual and directing organized beings to their ends; Académie9 records completed actuality, contrasted with an act in progress. Use the historical essential-form/realized-principle scope for this passage, not merely latent potentiality. No global or earlier French owner exists. Entéléchie/matière/possibilité/apparence are feminine singular noun labels; essential constitution differs from raw material, mere possibility or superficial appearance. This gloss does not endorse the speaker’s supposed Aristotle quotation.

Une raison par qui elle a la puissance d’être is presented by the speaker as an explanatory ground, not the faculty of rational thought, having right judgment or state interest. This contextual reading is an editorial inference from the sentence, supported by Académie’s cause/motive/explanation usage, and does not certify the attributed Aristotle wording. The published rationale, generic reason and earlier IV grounds banks were read. Add an explanatory-ground bank on the same proper rationale noun sense; before import reconcile its current action-focused definition with explanation of an entity and examine every current/historical dependent bank. Raison/conséquence/apparence/interdiction are feminine singular nouns after une; foundation differs from result, appearance or prohibition.

Déclare expressément marks the peripatetic’s claim that Aristotle stated this explicitly. No global or earlier French expressément adverb exists. All four adverbs fit the authored declaration frame; explicit formulation differs from vagueness, implication or silence. The bank explains manner of statement, not a verified claim about Aristotle or the cited edition.

The philosophers answer and speak simultaneously. The Chapter V full-span bank was read in all three bands and reused unchanged; neither repeated occasions nor one-after-another applies. The new exhaustive VII spans suppress component à/la/fois identities without copying mastery. Package04 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses. Preserve the existing whole-expression meaning and suppress only its exact components before import.

The philosophers agree on two or three understood points, contrasting their many disputes. The full agreeing predicate is prepared, excluding generic de and musical accord. Each alternative fits ils sont; shared opinion rather than disagreement, uncertainty or urgency selects agreement. Published d’accord component meanings require one canonical full-span route before import. Package04 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses. Preserve the existing whole-expression meaning and suppress only its exact components before import.

The Peripatetic says the proposition aloud. Haut is not spatial elevation, and tout intensifies the established vocal expression. All four manner phrases fit les dit; audibility rather than silence, secrecy or an inward thought selects tout haut. Before import reconcile any existing haut loud meaning into one whole-span route rather than duplicate word and phrase encounters. Package04 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses. Preserve the existing whole-expression meaning and suppress only its exact components before import.

The giant contrasts what is outside the philosophers with their interior soul and thinking. This figurative inward domain retains the inside/outside opposition; it does not mean bodily location alone. All four locative phrases fit se trouve. The whole locution is prepared so en is not incorrectly treated as a partitive pronoun. Package04 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses. Preserve the existing whole-expression meaning and suppress only its exact components before import.

Académie 1762 regarder explicitly gives regarder quelqu’un de haut en bas for showing contempt or disdain. The source’s tiny cleric claims universal knowledge and human primacy before giants; this contextual application is an editorial inference supported by the conventional idiom, rather than a mere vertical survey. The earlier unresolved gaze draft was inspected. All four adverbial phrases fit regarde; contempt rather than respect, curiosity or indifference selects the whole locution. Package04 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses. Preserve the existing whole-expression meaning and suppress only its exact components before import.

The philosophers give the lunar distance as a rounded quantity. The question tests rounding and does not endorse a modern astronomical measurement. Each manner phrase fits exprimée; round approximation rather than exactness, absence of a number or ordering selects the target. Nominal rond is not physical circularity here. Package04 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses. Preserve the existing whole-expression meaning and suppress only its exact components before import.

Au moins sets a minimal question about whether the speaker knows matter at all, rather than a maximum or merely chronological condition. The earlier V minimum phrase bank and its three questions were read unchanged; preserve its meaning and suppress the new au component on this complete source span. Package04 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses. Preserve the existing whole-expression meaning and suppress only its exact components before import.

The promised philosophy book would reveal final understanding of reality, while its eventual blankness makes that promise ironic. Le bout des choses denotes ultimate explanation, not a physical extremity. Prepare the complete phrase under a proper expression owner and compare its conceptual endpoint overlap with the broad published bout before import. All four masculine singular complete noun phrases fit verraient; knowledge rather than spatial edges, room location or elapsed time selects the target. Earlier des/choses word routes must be suppressed on this exact span before import. Package04 re-read the complete earlier three-band bank unchanged for these exact phrase uses. Preserve the existing whole-expression meaning and suppress only its exact components before import.

Le cartésien prit la parole introduces the next speaker in the philosophers’ exchange. Académie records prendre la parole as speaking or making a speech in an assembly. This is a complete idiom, not literal seizing, undertaking a commitment or resigning oneself. All four full past-tense predicates fit il; beginning speech rather than silence, departure or closing a book selects the phrase. Before import suppress the earlier isolated parole occurrence on this exact span and preserve all other speech-word mastery.

Ce qui est hors de vous contrasts external objects with en dedans, the philosophers’ inner soul and ideas. This external-location construction has no matching global or earlier expression owner. All four prepositional labels accept the same complement; externality differs from interior, above or below. Prepare the complete hors de span rather than a separate de meaning, without creating a psychological-exterior-only sense.

reviewBasis: Full source thought units, independently written meaning clues, every middle alternative, noun number and agreement, distinct meanings and explicit ownership dependencies were individually inspected. Structural checks verify revision and coverage, never editorial approval.
